rules.statement: The obligations imposed on the executor by the will are not purely personal but attached to the properties devised, creating a trust.
rules.supporting_quote: "The present case does not seem to me a case of a legacy, subject either to a conditio or modus .... The properties accorded to the executor by the testator arc not accorded to him as a free gift, but only subject to the liberalities accorded to Ms wife and children. Until these are satisfied, the administration of the estate is not concluded.'"
